import unittest

from solution import MonitorAdapter


class Backend:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.config_arg = None

    def initialize(self, config):
        self.config_arg = config
        self.calls.append(("initialize", config))
        config["nested"]["values"].append(999)

    def start(self):
        self.calls.append(("start",))

    def close(self):
        self.calls.append(("close",))

    def log(self, level, message, category):
        self.calls.append(("log", level, message, category))

    def target(self, symbol, quantity):
        self.calls.append(("target", symbol, quantity))


class MonitorAdapterTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_initialization_deep_copies_for_backend_and_snapshot(self):
        backend = Backend()
        adapter = MonitorAdapter(backend)
        config = {"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}, "flags": [True]}
        self.assertIsNone(adapter.config_snapshot())
        adapter.initialize(config)
        config["nested"]["values"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(adapter.config_snapshot(), {"nested": {"values": [1, 2]}, "flags": [True]})
        snapshot = adapter.config_snapshot()
        snapshot["nested"]["values"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(adapter.config_snapshot()["nested"]["values"], [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(backend.config_arg["nested"]["values"], [1, 2, 999])

    def test_forwarding_and_utf8_encoding(self):
        backend = Backend()
        adapter = MonitorAdapter(backend)
        adapter.initialize({})
        adapter.run()
        adapter.write_log(7, "café", "audit")
        adapter.write_log(-1, "plain")
        adapter.set_position("ÉQ", -4)
        self.assertIn(("start",), backend.calls)
        self.assertIn(("log", 7, "café".encode("utf-8"), b"audit"), backend.calls)
        self.assertIn(("log", -1, b"plain", None), backend.calls)
        self.assertIn(("target", "ÉQ".encode("utf-8"), -4), backend.calls)

    def test_requires_initialization(self):
        adapter = MonitorAdapter(Backend())
        for operation in [adapter.run, lambda: adapter.write_log(1, "x"),
                          lambda: adapter.set_position("X", 1)]:
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                operation()

    def test_release_is_idempotent_and_blocks_other_operations(self):
        backend = Backend()
        adapter = MonitorAdapter(backend)
        adapter.initialize({"x": []})
        adapter.release()
        adapter.release()
        self.assertEqual(backend.calls.count(("close",)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(adapter.config_snapshot(), {"x": []})
        for operation in [adapter.run, lambda: adapter.initialize({}),
                          lambda: adapter.write_log(1, "x"),
                          lambda: adapter.set_position("X", 1)]:
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                operation()

    def test_release_before_initialize_is_allowed_once(self):
        backend = Backend()
        adapter = MonitorAdapter(backend)
        adapter.release()
        adapter.release()
        self.assertEqual(backend.calls, [("close",)])
        self.assertIsNone(adapter.config_snapshot())

    def test_initialize_once_and_argument_validation(self):
        adapter = MonitorAdapter(Backend())
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            adapter.initialize([])
        adapter.initialize({})
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            adapter.initialize({})
        for args in [(True, "m", None), (1.5, "m", None), (1, 2, None), (1, "m", 3)]:
            with self.subTest(args=args), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                adapter.write_log(*args)
        for args in [("", 1), ("   ", 1)]:
            with self.subTest(args=args), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                adapter.set_position(*args)
        for args in [(4, 1), ("X", True), ("X", 1.2)]:
            with self.subTest(args=args), self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                adapter.set_position(*args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
